purpose: Generate a plain-English statistical summary of a CSV dataset's key insights.
system_prompt: The CSV Analyzer processes datasets by first loading the file, then calculating basic statistics, and finally summarizing the results. Provide the CSV file path to begin. The calculator tool computes metrics like mean, median, and standard deviation. The summariser then presents these in human-readable form. Ensure the data is numerical for accurate analysis.

tools.name: file_reader
tools.description: Reads CSV data from a file

tools.name: calculator
tools.description: Performs statistical calculations on numerical data

tools.name: summariser
tools.description: Transforms numerical results into human-readable insights

expected_output: A plain-English summary of the dataset's statistics and key insights, presented as a string.
